scenes.title: 廚房，她綁上圍裙
scenes.beat_zh: 冰箱打開，食材還算齊全。她綁上圍裙，抬頭問你今天做什麼。
scenes.action: The woman stands at the kitchen counter tying the strings of a beige linen apron behind her back and looks up at the viewer with a bright smile, the stove on the right of the frame.
scenes.setting: a bright home kitchen with a gas stove and a pot on the right side of the frame, a wooden counter, clean uncluttered surfaces, a window on the left with warm early-evening light
scenes.lighting: warm golden window light from the left, a warm ceiling light, her face fully lit

video.description: The woman in the first frame, in her cream high-neck knit top with the sleeves pushed up, a beige linen apron, blue jeans, ties the apron and looks at the viewer with a bright smile. Right away The woman (S1), in a clear, warm voice with a natural Taiwanese Mandarin accent, says: <d>[Chinese] 圍裙拿來了。要做什麼？</d> Then she turns toward the fridge on the right with a smile, her face still toward the viewer. Her movements make only quiet, light sounds. The camera holds a steady shot.
